title: Create Backend API for Financial Data
description: Develop a backend API that fetches and updates financial data (income, expenses, net worth) from the database.
acceptance_criteria: API endpoints for income, expenses, and net worth are created.
API returns data in JSON format and handles errors gracefully.

sub_tasks.title: Create service layer business logic
sub_tasks.description: 🚨 CRITICAL: FIRST read .projexlight/context/requirements.md to understand the specific requirements for "Create Backend API for Financial Data". Look for the task's acceptance criteria and implement according to those exact specifications. 🚨 CRITICAL: FIRST read .projexlight/schemas/user-defined-schemas.sql to understand existing database tables and columns. REUSE existing tables - do not create new tables unless absolutely necessary. Implement service classes with business logic and data validation that work with the EXISTING schema. Follow the specific API requirements and acceptance criteria from requirements.md
dependencies: Task 0: Database and auth system must exist
MANDATORY: Read requirements.md AND schema file first

sub_tasks.title: Implement API route handlers
sub_tasks.description: 🚨 CRITICAL: FIRST search existing route files (server/src/routes/*.ts) for similar API endpoints. REUSE existing route patterns and consolidate similar routes. Look for patterns like /api/users/:id, /api/items/:id that can be generalized. Only create new route files if the endpoint is completely different. Create Express route handlers with proper error handling
dependencies: Task 0: Server and middleware must exist
MANDATORY: Search existing routes before creating new ones

sub_tasks.title: Add input validation and error handling
sub_tasks.description: Implement request validation, error middleware, and response formatting

sub_tasks.title: Write unit tests for service layer
sub_tasks.description: Create unit tests with mocks for service methods
dependencies: Task 0: Testing framework must be configured

sub_tasks.title: Write integration tests for API endpoints
sub_tasks.description: Create integration tests for route handlers with test database
dependencies: Task 0: Server and database must be running
